provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific measurement/decision example; stipulated model inputs and observations, not new experimental findings.
provenance.scope: All required information, units and inferential limits are in this document.

constraint: Mixture weights are nonnegative and sum exactly1. All interval bounds hold simultaneously; their upper endpoints cannot necessarily be used together. Conditional model risks in each stratum are stipulated known and stable across this target-mixture shift. Each model must be chosen before the target mixture is revealed.
selection: For each fixed model maximize its expected risk over the entire feasible mixture polytope, then choose the model minimizing that maximum. Compare with equal-stratum weighting, which is merely one feasible mixture. Ties within1e-10 use lexicographically smaller model ID.
scope: Worst-case risk under this declared mixture set and invariant conditional risks; not a guarantee under arbitrary conditional distribution shift or uncertainty in the risk table.
